title: A content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet with no operator step beyond its gates
goal: A sprint whose committed items are one research item per gap finding of python3 _tools/querylog.py queue (at least three) runs through /kb-sprint run with every worker a headless claude -p --model sonnet session; every item lands and closes its gap finding (a Resolved note under its _gaps.md entry naming the finding id, DOC or CODE facts in the topic, python3 _tools/backlog.py cost --research listing the item with at least one closed gap); the operator's only steps are the sprint's start gate and the gates the items raise; and the review files its gaps as parked drafts (ST: review gaps park). The sprint's close commit is this story's evidence.
notes: Queue on 2026-10-07: 5 gap findings (python3 _tools/querylog.py queue), all raised by the kb's own development sessions; a real user's gap, when one arrives, goes first. Depends on ST-r7wvfqvw (Sonnet headless default, SP-d3hybrlv) so the run is the cheap one; a run before that lands is still evidence if every worker was started headless by hand. Benchmarking of the kb (retrieval, answer rate, cost per closed gap from backlog.py cost --research) starts with this sprint, not after the backlog is empty.
